title: Parentage of child of assisted reproduction.
bodyText: An individual who consents under section 584A-804 to assisted reproduction by another individual with the intent to be a parent of a child conceived by the assisted reproduction is a parent of the child.
bodyHtml: [§584A-803]  Parentage of child of assisted reproduction.  An individual who consents under section 584A-804 to assisted reproduction by another individual with the intent to be a parent of a child conceived by the assisted reproduction is a parent of the child. [L 2025, c 298, pt of §2]
